derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in fraction-stress.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Rail
boxes.derivation: 23 15/16" long (383/16), 1 1/16" wide, 3/16" thick, all exact at 1/16": lies flat at the origin. Occupies x 0..23 15/16.

boxes.name: Strip
boxes.derivation: 10 3/32" long (323/32 = 10336 units), 5/64" wide (80 units), 1/16" thick (64 units): all on the 1/1024 grid, none but the thickness on the 1/16 grid. Placed 1" clear of the rail: x 25..35 3/32.

boxes.name: Spacer
boxes.derivation: 6 1/16" long (exact), 3/32" wide (96 units) and 5/64" thick (80 units) - two off-grid sizes. Placed 1 15/16" clear of the strip (which ends at 35 3/32): x 37..43 1/16.

boxes.name: Third
boxes.derivation: One third of an inch cannot be stored: the closest legal length is 341 units (0.33301"), what Length.Divide does (geometry-model 1.1 table). 1/16" x 1/16" cross-section. x 45..45 341/1024.

cutList.label: Strip
cutList.derivation: Length 10336 units; 3/32" is 1.5 sixteenths, so 10 3/32 shows 10 1/8 - half away from zero (geometry-model 1.4), marked approx. Width 5/64" = 1.25 sixteenths -> 1/16, approx. Thickness 1/16" exact, unmarked.

cutList.label: Spacer
cutList.derivation: 6 1/16" = 6208 units, exact. Width 3/32" = 96 units -> 2/16 = 1/8, approx (tie rounds away). Thickness 5/64" = 80 units -> 1/16, approx.

cutList.label: Third
cutList.derivation: 341 units / 1024 x 16 = 5.33 sixteenths -> 5/16, approx; the two 1/16" sides are exact.
